svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Data lake on AWS subtitle: Streaming and database sources land in S3; Glue refines them zone by zone for Athena, Redshift and Quick Sight direction: down # Down keeps the labels readable at README width. simplex keeps Catalog and governance beside the # data zones instead of in the first row. layout: { layering: simplex } legend: solid: Data flow dotted: Metadata and permissions groups: sources: { type: zone, label: Sources } cloud: { type: aws:cloud } region: { type: aws:region, label: us-east-1, in: cloud } raw-zone: { type: zone, label: Raw zone, in: region } curated-zone: { type: zone, label: Curated zone, in: region } analytics-zone: { type: zone, label: Analytics zone, in: region } governance: { type: zone, label: Catalog and governance, in: region } nodes: apps: { icon: aws:mobile-client, label: Web and mobile apps, in: sources } ordersdb: { icon: logos:postgresql, label: Orders database, note: PostgreSQL, in: sources } firehose: { icon: aws:firehose, label: Amazon Data Firehose, in: region } dms: { icon: aws:dms, label: AWS Database Migration Service, note: Change data capture, in: region } raw: { icon: aws:simple-storage-service-bucket, label: Raw bucket, note: "Amazon S3, JSON and CSV", in: raw-zone } clean: { icon: aws:glue, label: AWS Glue, note: Clean and convert job, in: curated-zone } curated: { icon: aws:simple-storage-service-bucket, label: Curated bucket, note: Parquet, in: curated-zone } analytics: { icon: aws:simple-storage-service-bucket, label: Analytics bucket, note: Iceberg tables, in: analytics-zone } aggregate: { icon: aws:glue, label: AWS Glue, note: Aggregate job, in: analytics-zone } crawler: { icon: aws:glue-crawler, label: AWS Glue crawlers, note: Discover table schemas, in: governance } catalog: { icon: aws:glue-data-catalog, label: AWS Glue Data Catalog, in: governance } lf: { icon: aws:lake-formation, label: AWS Lake Formation, note: Permissions, in: governance } athena: { icon: aws:athena, label: Amazon Athena, in: region } redshift: { icon: aws:redshift, label: Amazon Redshift, in: region } quicksight: { icon: aws:quick, label: Amazon Quick Sight, in: region } edges: - apps -> firehose -> raw - ordersdb -> dms -> raw - raw -> clean # constraint: false puts each zone's Glue job and bucket side by side instead of in two rows. - { from: clean, to: curated, constraint: false } - curated -> aggregate - { from: aggregate, to: analytics, constraint: false } - analytics -> athena, redshift - athena, redshift -> quicksight # Metadata and permissions are dotted. - { from: [crawler, lf], to: catalog, line: dotted, constraint: false } - catalog ..> athena, redshift: table metadata

svg.title: Data lake on AWS
svg.desc: Data lake on AWS. 15 components in 7 groups. Connections: Web and mobile apps to Amazon Data Firehose; Amazon Data Firehose to Raw bucket; Orders database to AWS Database Migration Service; AWS Database Migration Service to Raw bucket; Raw bucket to AWS Glue; AWS Glue to Curated bucket; Curated bucket to AWS Glue; AWS Glue to Analytics bucket; Analytics bucket to Amazon Athena; Analytics bucket to Amazon Redshift; Amazon Athena to Amazon Quick Sight; Amazon Redshift to Amazon Quick Sight; AWS Glue crawlers to AWS Glue Data Catalog; AWS Lake Formation to AWS Glue Data Catalog; AWS Glue Data Catalog to Amazon Athena (table metadata); AWS Glue Data Catalog to Amazon Redshift (table metadata).

text.tspan: Streaming and database sources land in S3; Glue refines them zone by zone for Athena, Redshift and Quick Sight
